claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActivatedAbilityMechanics without mandatory resource/reset
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item is activated with a Magic action but has no charges, uses, or recharge cadence. The current activation surface forces a false resource model.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can make this carpet hover and fly by taking a Magic action and using the carpet's command word.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.item or Attachment.object for activation phases
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The activated subject is the carpet itself, not the user or another creature. Existing attachments cannot target the item being commanded.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can make this carpet hover and fly ... It moves according to your directions

claude_proposed_widenings.name: EffectAtom.move for commanded item movement
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The surface can force-move creatures or grant creature speed, but it cannot express persistent commanded motion of an object/item even though v4 includes a move atom.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: It moves according to your directions if you are within 30 feet of it.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: movement speed modifier gated by carried-load threshold
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The carpet's speed depends on whether its carried load exceeds normal capacity. Current predicates do not model weight/load thresholds for movement.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A carpet can carry up to twice the weight shown on the table, but its Fly Speed is halved if it carries more than its normal capacity.
